Match officials for Matchweek 6

05 Oct 2026

See who will be officiating in the sixth round of 2026/27 fixtures, including the Video Assistant Referees

The match officials for Matchweek 6 of the 2026/27 Premier League season have been appointed.

Referee: Paul Tierney. Assistants: Richard West, Steve Meredith. Fourth official: Oliver Langford. VAR: Tony Harrington. Assistant VAR: Nick Greenhalgh.

Referee: Craig Pawson. Assistants: Lee Betts, Mat Wilkes. Fourth official: Anthony Backhouse. VAR: Peter Bankes. Assistant VAR: Ian Hussin.

Referee: Sam Barrott. Assistants: Adam Nunn, Wade Smith. Fourth official: Elliot Bell. VAR: John Brooks. Assistant VAR: James Mainwaring.

Referee: Lewis Smith. Assistants: Scott Ledger, Akil Howson. Fourth official: John Busby. VAR: James Bell. Assistant VAR: Alex Chilowicz.

Referee: Tom Bramall. Assistants: Gary Beswick, Craig Taylor. Fourth official: Steve Martin. VAR: Neil Davies. Assistant VAR: Adrian Holmes.

Referee: Stuart Attwell (pictured). Assistants: Constantine Hatzidakis, Nick Hopton. Fourth official: Rob Jones. VAR: Jarred Gillett. Assistant VAR: Stuart Burt.

Referee: Peter Bankes. Assistants: Ian Hussin, Mark Stevens. Fourth official: Sam Barrott. VAR: Darren England. Assistant VAR: Richard West.

Referee: Michael Salisbury. Assistants: Adrian Holmes, Simon Long. Fourth official: Will Finnie. VAR: Tim Wood. Assistant VAR: Mat Wilkes.

Referee: Chris Kavanagh. Assistants: Dan Cook, Nick Greenhalgh. Fourth official: Andy Madley. VAR: Paul Howard. Assistant VAR: Nick Hopton.
